sentences.en: The surgeon persuaded me to undergo an organ transplant operation.
sentences.zh: 那名外科医生说服我接受器官移植手术。

sentences.en: For better or worse, she will have the operation tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 不管好坏，她明天就要动手术了。

sentences.en: The system will go into operation in a short time.
sentences.zh: 该系统将在短时间内投入使用。

senses.zh: 操作, 运转, 经营 - 手术 - (军事)行动, 活动 - 〈数〉运算
